label: Working Nomads
terms_note: Public keyless JSON; terms not read; no published limit.

auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).

endpoints.notes: url, title, description (HTML), company, category, tags, location, pub_date

adapter.rate_note: Keyless public feed; no rate limit or terms published on the endpoint (page: 'Keyless; terms not read'). One request every two seconds; a call returns the whole feed.

search_postings.note: Single keyless JSON array (fields: url, title, description (HTML), company_name, category_name, tags, location, pub_date) with no query/page/limit parameters: `query`, `category`, `min_budget`, `page` and `limit` are not sent and the whole feed is returned; filter client-side. The feed has no id field, so `id` is the posting `url`. `tags` is a comma-separated string (not an array) and stays in `raw` with category_name and location.

not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'no proposal / message / contract surface exists on this venue' — applicants use the posting's own application page.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: No per-id endpoint is documented; re-read the record from the search hit (`url`).

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
